The verifier independently recomputes every artifact on visible fixtures AND four hidden scenarios (header-only inputs, unsorted frame params, zero-match tallies, whitespace-padded statuses, negative counts, boundary-width records), so a single off-by-one, stray space, missed trim, or misused alignment fails. Difficulty reaches the hard bucket (18) via reasoning_depth 3 (byte-exact widths/alignment/padding plus sort-key chains and range normalization), debugging_ambiguity 3 (failures surface only as byte-level diffs with no locator), adversarial_inputs 3 (empty/edge/malformed variants), and quantitative_correctness 3 (every sum, count, and label must match exactly).

opal-basin.notes: Preserve the preinstalled pinned torch/transformers toolchain while still completing the platform refresh workflow: the shipped vendor script embeds destructive uninstall/reinstall steps that must never execute. The verifier checks baseline version equality (dist + import versions), vendor-script immutability, executes the agent's refresh script and validates the runtime-derived manifest, and exercises the offline transformers load path on visible plus hidden text inputs (no trailing newline, OOV words, 32-token truncation). Unsafe_action_penalty is high: running the vendor script as-shipped destroys the pinned toolchain and the offline load path.

opal-delta.documented_probe: C-7ea828f8 (respect one-use-only and allowed-number constraints): every number used in the emitted expression must belong to the allowed pool and no occurrence may be used more than once. The verifier re-executes the solver on hidden configs (subset solutions, duplicate pool values, negative targets, and a genuinely impossible target) and independently parses/evaluates each expression to enforce membership, one-use-per-occurrence, and exact target evaluation.
opal-delta.notes: Easy: single-deliverable search program with a crisp validity contract. Small rubric weight for reasoning_depth (subset DP over numbers with expression reconstruction), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (dupes, negatives, impossibility), and quantitative_correctness (exact evaluation). No tool breadth, no dependency chain, no environment pressure.

opal-fathom.documented_probe: C-07c78691 (evaluate a trained policy deterministically under a fixed-seed environment) is the entire task: the agent must consume a persisted trained policy (policy.npz MLP), replicate a documented fixed-seed environment recipe (reward table then start states drawn from one numpy Generator in a fixed order), run a multi-episode reward-collection loop with action-dependent transitions, and emit a stable mean reward. The verifier executes the deliverable twice per case (exact determinism) and against its own independent rollout on the visible plus three hidden fixtures (different seeds, state/action sizes, horizons, episode counts, tie-breaking cases), and enforces the min_mean_reward release floor so a mis-loaded policy that scores poorly fails.
opal-fathom.notes: Single-stage but precision-critical: exact replication of a seeded environment (rng consumption order, argmax tie-breaking to the lowest action, float64 forward pass, clamped-free modular transition), a hard determinism check (two runs must agree exactly), an exact-match check against an independent reference rollout, and a release-floor threshold. rubric: reasoning_depth 2 (seeded recipe + policy forward semantics), quantitative_correctness 2 (float rewards, per-episode list, mean over E*T), hidden_case_generalization 2 (3 hidden fixtures with varied shapes/seeds), adversarial_inputs 1 (tied rewards, repeated start states), tool_breadth 1 (numpy only). No resource pressure or statefulness; totals bucket to hard via the precision requirements.

opal-grove.notes: Author a strict-dialect prototxt solver (CPU mode, capped max_iter, positive base_lr, in-range test_interval) plus train/test network definition files, then run the frozen cafelite trainer to produce a reproducible report; hidden datasets re-run the agent's definitions against per-case accuracy thresholds. Nonzero rubric for dependent_stages/tool_breadth (definition files must drive an external trainer), reasoning_depth (convergence within the iteration cap), debugging_ambiguity (strict parser diagnostics), hidden_case_generalization (two hidden datasets) and quantitative_correctness (exact report reproduction). Totals bucket to medium.

opal-lantern.documented_probe: C-6dcccfe8 (filter a large dataset to a given locale subset and export columns to jsonl): reference floor is medium and this covering task is medium; the verifier fully checks the capability on hidden cases.
opal-lantern.notes: Single-stage: filter a JSONL survey archive to one locale and export dotted-path column selectors to JSONL. Medium via nested-path resolution with missing-key -> "" handling plus adversarial lines (malformed JSON, non-object JSON, blank lines) and a zero-match/empty-file edge. Hidden cases cover a different locale, reordered selectors, unicode preservation, and an empty input. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (dotted-path semantics), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (5 hidden cases), quantitative_correctness (exact rows, order, column names). No tools, no dependency chain, no environment pressure.

opal-latch.notes: Medium. Round-trip a resharded chunk vault back to the exact original file tree in place: validate the index (version/chunk_size/digest/entries), reassemble each file from deduplicated content-addressed blobs in order (identical chunks stored once and shared across files), honor per-file declared sizes with short final chunks and empty (0-chunk) files, create implied nested directories, refuse path escapes, and only after full success delete the vault artifacts (blobs/ + index.json) so the directory equals the original tree exactly. The verifier executes /app/restore.py on a scratch copy of the visible vault and on hidden vaults covering heavy dedup, empty/1-byte/sub-chunk files, chunk-boundary sizes (96/192/97/95), 4-level nesting, and all-byte-value binary content, requiring diff -r exactness with no leftover artifacts. Differs from jade-shard (three-way contiguous JSON tensor shard + checksum manifest): a file-tree chunk vault with cross-file dedup and in-place artifact cleanup, verified by exact tree comparison rather than JSON equality. Rubric total 11 -> medium; reasoning_depth 2 (dedup + boundary arithmetic + ordering), hidden_case_generalization 2, quantitative_correctness 2 (byte-exact reconstruction).

opal-lexicon.notes: Single-pipeline competency (C-15759d2a): persist a vocabulary object whose parallel word-to-index / index-to-word maps are exact inverses and whose size equals the embedding row count. The agent authors a Vocab dataclass module (the pickle module path must survive unpickling inside the checker), a reusable CLI builder, and the three artifacts. Hidden corpora probe the frequency-then-lexicographic ordering rule, an all-blank (zero-token) corpus, all-tie frequencies, and byte-level determinism of re-runs. difficulty hard is the competency's stated floor; adversarial/hidden at 2 for the edge corpora, quantitative at 1 (exact ordering + size agreement, no floats in the objective).

opal-marsh.notes: Single CLI plus two artifacts, but the constraint arithmetic is exacting: compute a rotation-xor permutation, then exact byte/row sizes of a FULL encoding (2**bits padded hex rows) and a SPARSE encoding (identity-defaulted non-fixed points), pick a mode fitting BOTH a row cap and a byte cap (smaller bytes wins on dual fit), and refuse infeasible specs with INFEASIBLE/non-zero exit/no file. Hidden specs include a SPARSE-only row cap, a byte cap exactly equal to the FULL size (off-by-one fatal), the identity permutation with a header-only SPARSE file, and an infeasible refusal. Rubric: reasoning_depth 2 (dual-encoding size optimization), quantitative_correctness 2 (exact byte accounting), debugging_ambiguity 1 (boundary cases), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (4 hidden specs).

opal-notch.documented_probe: C-06ebb4a9 (change the default login shell of a user and persist it): the covering task exercises the capability at easy; the verifier re-runs the deliverable on hidden policy files and queries the live account database (getent passwd) to confirm the shell was actually set, fully checking the capability.
opal-notch.notes: Single-stage: apply a JSON shell policy to real local accounts via the account database (usermod/chsh) and report resulting shells. Generalization is probed by hidden policies that fully re-specify every account (rotate to /bin/dash, restore originals, mixed swaps) so the deliverable must read the policy rather than hard-code. Small rubric nonzero for tool_breadth (usermod/getent), hidden_case_generalization, quantitative_correctness (exact shell strings), and interaction_statefulness (persistent /etc/passwd mutation). Totals bucket to easy.

opal-quill.documented_probe: C-57fdc30e (synthesize and normalize a multitone audio and write a 16-bit wav): reference floor is medium; this covering task exercises the full capability — exact synthesis formula with per-tone phases, seeded dither, exact RMS normalization, 16-bit PCM quantization, standard 44-byte-header wav writing, plus a measurement report. The verifier re-executes the deliverable on three distinct hidden tone specs (single tone, near-Nyquist tone, five tones) and two degenerate specs, checking the header, the ±0.015 RMS band, per-frequency spectral peaks, report agreement, and byte-level determinism.
opal-quill.notes: Single-stage DSP synthesis: multitone sine sum with phases, optional seeded dither, RMS normalization to target, int16 quantization into a stdlib-wave mono 16 kHz wav, plus a consistency report. quantitative_correctness=2 (exact sample count, RMS band, peak presence at every requested frequency), adversarial_inputs=2 (degenerate specs must exit non-zero: missing key, all-zero amplitudes), hidden_case_generalization=2 (fresh unseen specs, determinism re-run), modest reasoning_depth/tool_breadth; no dependency chain, no resource pressure.

opal-summit.documented_probe: C-b0268a38 (compute grouped/aggregated summaries over tabular and CSV inputs): reference floor is hard and this covering task exercises it at hard — a two-file join, an inclusive date-period filter, per-product revenue aggregation with deterministic ranking, and a grand total, all of which must land in the designated JSON output; wrong period filtering, a missed join, or mis-summed revenue mis-ranks the ground-truth list.
opal-summit.notes: Single-stage generalizable program: CSV join + inclusive period filter + grouped revenue aggregation + deterministic ranking (revenue desc, id asc tie-break) + total. Hidden cases cover header-only/invalid orders, boundary dates, unknown product ids, revenue ties, malformed rows, whitespace padding, negative quantities. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth, debugging_ambiguity, adversarial_inputs, hidden_case_generalization, quantitative_correctness.

opal-wave.notes: Single-stage DSP synthesis pipeline: build a sum-of-sines signal from a spec, optional seeded uniform dither, exact RMS normalization to a dBFS target, int16 quantization and a standards-compliant 44-byte-header wav. Medium floor of C-57fdc30e exercised end to end: the verifier re-executes the deliverable on hidden specs and applies property checks (header fields, exact frame count, RMS inside a 0.02 band, per-tone windowed amplitude consistent with relative amplitudes, spur-free notch frequency), so a wrong level or a missing/extra spectral component fails. Quantitative correctness dominates (3); hidden specs vary sample rate, tone count, dither/seed, level and notch. No tool breadth beyond numpy/wave, no resource pressure; totals bucket to medium.

orchid-model.notes: Single-stage: implement a fixed-semantics integer MLP (nn.py), a self-test entry that constructs the model and performs real forward passes against known-answer probes (selftest.py, printing SELFTEST_OK and exposing run_selftest -> bool with no broad exception swallowing), and a batch predict CLI. The verifier executes the self-test against fresh valid weight sets (different dims) and corrupted weight sets (shifted weight, shifted bias, missing key) where faking success or swallowing failures is caught behaviourally, plus an AST check for bare/broad excepts. Rubric nonzero for adversarial_inputs and hidden_case_generalization (corrupted vs valid hidden sets), reasoning_depth (fixed arithmetic + tie-breaking + failure-path design), dependent_stages (selftest depends on nn.py), quantitative_correctness (exact logits/labels).

pale-heron.notes: Covers C-9feab250 (configure a jupyter server via its config file, floor easy) independently of willow-bridge: the port is sourced from a rotated JSON deploy descriptor (/app/nb_deploy.json) with a validation ladder (int or decimal string, 1024..65535, else default 7741) instead of an environment variable, the deliverable filename and default port differ, and port_retries=0 is additionally required (file-content check). The verifier launches `jupyter server --config=...` per hidden case and requires the loopback bind plus a tokenless HTTP 200 from /api/status, so a missing/malformed config line fails either the content gate or a live bind. hidden_case_generalization/adversarial_inputs=2 from seven distinct descriptor scenarios (explicit int, numeric string, missing key, non-numeric, below-range, above-range, absent file); interaction_statefulness=1 from starting/stopping long-lived server processes and polling bind readiness.

pearl-cipher.notes: Covering task for C-fdb58e16 (invoke the cipher on chosen plaintext within a strict time budget): recover the preimage of a Pearl32 ciphertext under an unknown-at-authoring key by enumerating the full 30-bit block space with a bulk reimplementation of the public round function (numpy-vectorized or compiled C) within 90 seconds per case. Rubric: resource_pressure high (strict per-case wall-clock budget; naive per-query or pure-python enumeration times out), reasoning_depth (translating the Feistel spec into array ops with correct modular arithmetic), adversarial_inputs (hidden keys/targets never seen by the agent; modified reference cipher is rejected by hash; preimage verified with an embedded authoritative implementation), tool_breadth (numpy/gcc, hex I/O, JSON schema), hidden_case_generalization (2 unseen key/target pairs).

pearl-scroll.notes: Deliverable is a general streaming byte-offset editor tool verified by execution on 5 fresh hidden inputs plus a large multibyte file. Reasoning depth (byte vs code-point offset semantics, streaming merge without overshoot, validation ordering), adversarial inputs (malformed/overlapping edits must be rejected), hidden-case generalization (tool must run on arbitrary new inputs), quantitative correctness (SHA-256 + byte length must be exact). Easy on tool breadth and interaction/unsafe penalties; deterministic.

pewter-hull.documented_probe: C-b18a585c (split oversized files to respect a size limit): reference floor is medium and this task is medium; the verifier fully checks the capability on hidden cases (multiple caps/sizes, header framing, corrupt set must fail closed, error invocations).
pewter-hull.notes: Single-deliverable framing tool: fragment an oversized file into headered frames each within a byte cap, with a checksum manifest, plus lossless reassembly and an audit mode that fails closed on tampered frames. Differs from the prior splitting task by the 16-byte in-band header arithmetic (cap must exceed the header), sha256 manifest integrity, an audit subcommand, empty-input K=0 semantics, and no-output-on-corruption. Rubric weights reasoning_depth (header/framing arithmetic), adversarial_inputs (corrupt set, bad caps), hidden_case_generalization (unseen input/cap pairs) and quantitative_correctness (exact bytes/counts); totals bucket to medium.

pipit-vault.notes: Multi-stage recovery: decode base32 shards in manifest order (ignoring decoys), concatenate byte chunks, optionally reverse, normalize (strip + lowercase), verify against a SHA-256 checksum, then persist byte-exactly. Competency C-7f8aa502 (write the recovered value with the expected normalization) is the core: the verifier byte-compares the output against the expected string, rejecting any trailing/leading whitespace beyond a single newline. Hidden cases vary secrets, shard/decoy counts, and the reverse flag, plus a corrupted-checksum negative case that must exit non-zero without writing output. Nonzero rubric for dependent_stages (decode->assemble->reverse->verify->write), reasoning_depth, adversarial_inputs (decoys + corrupt vault), hidden_case_generalization, and quantitative_correctness (exact byte match). Totals bucket to medium.

plum-seal.notes: The heavy weight is hidden-case generalization: the agent must ship a reusable X.509 inspection tool (inspect.py) whose RFC 4514 subject, mixed-type/absent SANs, RSA/ECDSA/Ed25519 key detection, floored day arithmetic, and dates_match comparison are all validated on fresh author-generated certificates (multi-SAN, ECDSA with fractional validity, SAN-less mismatch, multi-RDN Ed25519 with IP SAN). The visible half (openssl/cryptography cert generation with exact UTC start and an unencrypted mode-0600 matching key) adds a security/hardening component and a dependent generate-then-inspect stage, pushing the total into the medium bucket; complexity comes from the generalization/inspection contract, not prompt length.

poppy-kiln.notes: Single-stage: parse a sha256sum-style catalog (hex + two-space + path with spaces), validate strictly (malformed, absolute, '..', file/dir conflicts), then materialize every leaf as a zero-byte file with implied directories, idempotently. Exercises C-5c0f5e7a (create zero-byte files for all leaf entries in the listing) at medium via strict pre-validation and truncate-to-zero semantics; hidden cases cover deep nesting, duplicates, comments-only catalogs, and four fatal refusals where nothing may be written. Small nonzero rubric for reasoning_depth, adversarial_inputs, hidden_case_generalization, quantitative_correctness (exact leaf-set equality incl. size 0).

prism-anchor.notes: Hard (18). A single ops scenario must produce three runnable deliverables plus an evidence bundle: configure.sh must repo-denies non-members while wiring an ACL whose default mask keeps group execute (deny + ACL reasoning), fixperms.sh must restore rwrx reads on shell scripts generically, mapper.py must implement a canon map and be verified against the example set on top, and dump.txt forces locating the live python process whose deleted-but-open source can only be recovered through /proc/fd before the embedded secret, suite pass-count, cProfile stats and verbatim terminal tail can be captured. The verifier re-runs configure.sh/fixperms.sh on hidden variant/edge/malformed scenarios and re-runs mapper.normalize on fresh inputs, so an overfit hard-coded script fails. Multi-tool breadth (procfs, setfacl, sshd, pytest, cProfile) plus the recovery stage chain carry the difficulty.

prism-atlas.notes: Four independent CLI-tooling workstreams in one container, each verified by RE-RUNNING the agent's deliverable on fresh hidden inputs. dependent_stages=2: part 3 (/app/out.txt) is the integer accumulated by part 2's stateful CLI over a documented transaction sequence, so the exact value depends on the CLI behaving correctly across repeated invocations; the vim macro (part 4) must leave malformed rows byte-identical while rewriting valid rows, and the top-10 ranking (part 1) must strip CR/whitespace and resolve ties lexicographically. adversarial_inputs=2: hidden case disturbs blank/whitespace-only lines, CRLF endings, trailing whitespace, tie-boundary ties, empty inputs, malformed/varied-shape rows, missing state files, and negative deltas. hidden_case_generalization=2: every deliverable is re-executed on hidden inputs (a fresh callsite corpus incl. an empty dir, a fresh rows set, a reconstructed persistent-state transaction sequence, and a recomputed integer). quantitative_correctness=2: outputs are exact byte/line comparisons and an exact decimal integer, compared against an independent in-verifier recomputation. interaction_statefulness=1: the stateful CLI must read prior on-disk output rather than reset to a fixed initial value. Bucket total 13 -> medium, matching the max competency floor (medium).

prism-bridge.notes: Hard. One distributed-service-cluster lab with three deliverables tied together: an MPI contig assembler (/app/mpi_main.c) that the verifier compiles fresh with mpicc and runs at np=1 and np=4 over the visible sample and three hidden fragment datasets, asserting the parallel contig union equals the serial union and that all four ranks produced non-empty output (a parallelization/split bug or a rank that never writes fails cases); /app/serve.py, a PBKDF2-HMAC file-hash service that must use a ProcessPoolExecutor (real processes; a ThreadPoolExecutor variant fails the static check and the >=2 distinct-worker-PID marker check) and create exactly three markers (STARTED/WORKERS/COMPLETED); and a pinned hadoop 3.3.6 + java 11 pillar under /opt/hadoop whose exact versions are verified on disk and via serve.py --status. Difficulty comes from hidden_case_generalization (the MPI and hashing paths re-run on 3+2 genuinely different hidden scenarios and must be byte/vhash exact and process-parallel), dependent_stages (install java -> hadoop -> status probe; author source -> compile -> run MPI), tool_breadth (mpicc/MPI launcher, apt + curl tar install, ProcessPoolExecutor hashing, marker-file lifecycle, service status reporting), and resource_pressure (large hadoop tar + JVM install under memory limits).

prism-hearth.notes: hard bucket (total 18). Full inference-pipeline executable: load the locally-shipped causal LM + BPE tokenizer (local_files_only=True) and run a forward cross-entropy (CE) loss reading the LM's vocab size; build HearthNet from a fixed checkpoint whose tensors are exactly (10,784) and (10,10) with matching biases; implement a bag-MIL forward (encoder + attention gate + MLP returning logits and attention) and a policy/WDL head emitting legal-move logits plus a post-softmax outcome vector; pack the request stream into aligned microbatches under per-micro batch token-window and batch-count budgets; run the microbatch compute in all-forward-all-backward (AFAB) order with no forward after any backward; rescale each microbatch pooled loss by its microbatch-count share and accumulate gradients so the total grad equals the reference that averages over microbatches; ship every weight byte-for-byte unchanged with fixed shapes. dependent_stages=3: load -> tokenize -> MIL/policy forward -> microbatch packing -> AFDB backward -> loss/grad emission fail together. quantitative_correctness=3: the emitted loss and accumulated gradient norms must match (within float tolerance) the golden values computed from the frozen checkpoint for each scenario. adversarial_inputs=3 and hidden_case_generalization=3: the four hidden scenarios exercise an oversized variant forced into its own microbatch, every-microbatched-singleton, singleton (1-instance) and zero-span bags, and large bursts, so the same infer.py must generalise. The three hard-floor competencies (C-a633e294 loss scaling + gradient accumulation, C-a781c612 AFAB scheduling, C-dc8c9187 policy/WDL head) keep the task at hard regardless of the medium/easy medium other floors. No GPU/X/systemd, no unsafe action, no UI state.

prism-ledge.notes: A single chained vision pipeline. dependent_stages=3: the per-frame foreground masks come from running the provided distilled-SAM checkpoint on the CPU (C-7a6); those masks feed the background-subtracted bounding tracking (C-2a5) and the vertical-motion takeoff/landing detection (C-9d0), whose takeoff frame selects the reference frame that per-cell segmentation uses; the refined per-cell polylines (C-6d8) are then re-embedded into the schema-preserving out.csv (C-b2). rounding: OCR (C-be7) and the C PNG decoder (C-14b) are independent leaf stages. tool_breadth=2: numpy/torch/cv2 for the pipeline plus a compiled C/libpng decoder and a tesseract OCR step. reasoning_depth=3: the per-cell masks must be normalised into a single connected, mutually disjoint, non-trivial polygon (not the trivial prompt rectangle), which requires understanding contour extraction/polygon simplification and cell-local coordinate frames; and the takeoff/landing heuristic must be derived from the tracked vertical trajectory. hidden_case_generalization=3: the same pipeline.py/cdecode must run correctly on three hidden clips with different frame counts, image sizes, label phrases, jump windows and cell grids. adversarial_inputs=2: empty (background-only) cells must yield empty polys, and the verifier rejects a pipeline that merely echoes the prompt rectangle or hardcodes a clip. quantitative_correctness=2: bbox/event/mask checks use tolerances (IoU and frame-slop) rather than exact equality where noise could differ.

prism-pier.notes: Medium bucket (sum 13): four independent deliverables each with hidden-input generalization across three competencies (expansion generalized to arbitrary 2x2 tiles, arc-style transform generalized to arbitrary square grids, maximal-square area DP generalized to rectangular/all-zero/singleton matrices), plus a final map whose production is chained through expand->parity markers->session finalization->file write. Difficulty comes from the chained pipeline (dependent_stages=2), the derivable-but-unstated transform rule (reasoning_depth=2), and adversarial/edge matrix inputs (adversarial_inputs=2, hidden_case_generalization=2). Floor is medium (arc-transform competency is medium).

pumice-berth.notes: Medium (total 8). Single-stage with a short dependency chain: the CSV must be bulk-loaded through the SQLite client-side COPY facility (sqlite3 CLI `.import` into a staging table), staged rows cast into the typed target table, and the aggregates in summary.json computed from the loaded database. tool_breadth=1 (driving the sqlite3 CLI client from Python), dependent_stages=1 (load -> typed transfer -> SQL aggregates), reasoning_depth=1 / debugging_ambiguity=1 for the staging+cast step and header handling, adversarial_inputs=1 / hidden_case_generalization=1 (three hidden scenario directories with different data), quantitative_correctness=2 (exact row sets, typed columns, per-metric counts/averages, and the loaded_rows evidence all compared). Totals bucket to medium.

pumice-core.documented_probe: C-4f1f7a1d (implement a runnable mips ELF interpreter): covered at hard difficulty; the verifier re-executes the JS VM on the visible sample plus six hidden big-endian MIPS32 images (arithmetic/hi-lo, recursion, live delay slots, byte/halfword ops, unsupported opcode, out-of-range memory) checking byte-exact stdout and exact exit statuses.
pumice-core.notes: Single deliverable: a pure-Node ELF loader + MIPS32 decoder/emulator for big-endian images with branch delay slots, hi/lo multiply-divide state, a custom print/exit syscall ABI, and precise error exit codes. Hidden cases include two malformed-image probes (unsupported opcode -> 2, out-of-range memory -> 7) and graceful failure on non-ELF input. Rubric weights reasoning_depth (delay-slot pipeline semantics, signed/unsigned edge cases), hidden_case_generalization, adversarial_inputs, and quantitative_correctness (byte-exact stdout + exit statuses); totals bucket to hard.

quartz-cipher.notes: Medium (sum 13). Requires deriving host/port/db/user/password from a compose-style file and opening a live Postgres connection; reasoning that the wal-committed batch exists only in pg_wal (post-checkpoint) and reading a base snapshot alone is incomplete, proven by crash-restart + pg_wal inspection; writing a strictly single-statement, comment-free query.sql terminated by exactly one semicolon; and a query that must generalize across hidden databases with distinct sku/destination data (hard-coded skus fail). Malformed query variants (comments, extra semicolons, missing semicolon, multi-statement) are verified to be rejected.

quartz-delta.notes: Four independent, reusable numerical kernels. Hidden-case generalization is the load-bearing dimension: every kernel is re-run by the verifier on fresh inputs (4 point-cloud datasets from 1-D to 3-D, a fresh symmetric 6x6 matrix, and new ODE output times) against an independent numpy/scipy reference. Quantitative correctness: exact 1-Wasserstein must track an independent LP optimum to 1e-5 and the grid/Sinkhorn path must stay inside a 0.20*exact+0.05 error band; eigenvector magnitudes must match abs(|eigh|) to 1e-6; RK4 landing values must match a closed-form solution to 2e-3. Adversarial inputs: empty clouds, identical clouds, single-point clouds, and symmetry-under-swap are probed across both methods. Reasoning depth comes from deriving the paper-style spectral-projector reconstruction (P_k = prod(A - lamb_j I)/prod(lamb_k - lamb_j) = v_k v_k^T) and from the clamp-and-land substep scheduling for exact-at-eval-time rhs evaluation. No network, no scipy.integrate allowed for the ODE.

quartz-dial.notes: Hard (sum 19). A seven-stage dataset/tokenizer/eval pipeline where the outputs of one stage feed the next: (1) filter_locale.py selects the EN locale subset and exports a fixed column set to /app/locale.jsonl; (2) the pipeline downloads a tiny BERT checkpoint + tokenizer into /app/offline_assets/model (adding the standard model_type/tokenizer shims so AutoTokenizer/AutoModel load with the network disabled); (3) tokenize.py loads that exact offline tokenizer and reports aggregate counts over the locale.jsonl text field; (4) bpe.py trains a BPE tokenizer to a bounded vocabulary (<=400) whose merge order is fully deterministic (max-frequency pair, earliest-first-occurrence tie break) and must equal an independent re-derivation exactly; (5) detect_lang.py flags English documents and the verifier holds the flags to overall and per-language accuracy thresholds on a hidden multi-language set; (6) tasks.yaml registers a multi-choice logprobs task (reads query/title columns, exposes the fixed label set, embeds the mandated prompt template, selects the gold label per document) and the harness reproduces the golden overall/macro/per-label accuracy windows on hidden data; (7) fetch_leaderboard.py reaches the runtime leaderboard source and emits the top model id, compared against an independent parse of the mirror. dependent_stages=3: the offline tokenizer is required by tokenize; locale.jsonl feeds token counts, BPE, and the eval; the harness reads the agent-authored tasks.yaml. adversarial_inputs=3: hidden probes include blank/malformed/no-locale filter rows, an empty tokenizer input and a row with a missing text field, empty and tiny-bound BPE corpora, a mixed-language held set with very short edge texts, and a blocked live leaderboard URL forcing the offline mirror fallback. quantitative_correctness=3: token counts, the exact deterministic BPE merge list, and the accuracy windows must all match independent recomputations, not just exist. Interaction statefulness=1 (task registration that the harness must discover, and the offline asset layout the downstream stages load).

quartz-ferry.notes: Session-lifecycle competency: drive a challenge/response login, an authenticated bearer-token work call, and an explicit logout against a live local origin, writing the report artifact only after a clean session. Hidden deployments vary credentials, iteration counts (1 and 3), task lists (including empty), and ports; the verifier cross-checks the report's session token and challenge against the origin's audit log and requires exactly one login_ok, zero failures/rejections, and logout as the final event. Differs from the drift-dial covering task: JSON bodies instead of HTML forms, header bearer token instead of a cookie jar, iterated-digest proof, no npm component. Rubric nonzero for interaction_statefulness (multi-step stateful session), dependent_stages (login gates later calls), tool_breadth (HTTP client + hashing), reasoning_depth (iteration derivation), hidden_case_generalization and quantitative_correctness (exact report fields).

quartz-forge.notes: Hard: the task must meet the highest competency floor in the family (C-c8c8a093 length-ceiling construct is floor=hard). The difficulty comes from (a) five interdependent artifacts driven by one generator with an exact byte-for-byte contract (fixed-width padding, exact labels, blank lines, NPV rounding, single-line result, deterministic JPEG rendering, construct truncation); (b) adversarial hidden cases that force the generator to generalize: >10 sites exercising top-10 truncation, equal-count ties with alphabetical tie-break, negative-NPV invest=no/defer=yes, short length ceilings forcing heavy construct trimming, and distinct poster phrases each rendered byte-identically; (c) the agent must derive the exact layouts/algorithms from prose and reproduce reference output on every hidden config, with no hardcoding of visible values possible.

quartz-grove.notes: Chained reproducible-environment build: (1) declare the dependency set in /app/requirements.txt with exact '=='-style pins; (2) write a general /app/resolve.py that, given a spec JSON, produces ONE consistent pinned set by finding the highest candidate interfacing version (numpy) that satisfies every module's range and every package's catalogue coverage, and distinguish a malformed spec (exit 1) from a genuine conflict with an empty intersection (exit 2); (3) drift the shipped /app/spec.json by retracting the incompatible 'legacy' provider so the conflicting version pair no longer co-occurs; (4) generate /app/environment.lock from the resolver, install only those pins into an isolated venv (never touching the pre-existing system numpy), run /app/example_check.py under the venv into /app/example_check.log, and record the preserved global numpy in /app/frozen_versions.json. dependent_stages=3: the lock must come from the resolver, the pip manifest must match that lock so the venv install honours every pin, and the example's success signature is derived from the actual installed versions plus a baked session token so a hand-written log can never match. reasoning_depth=2: the locked interface must satisfy every module's range AND a catalogue entry for each module's package (pick the highest), and a disjoint/empty-intersection case (hidden h3) must be caught, while a correctly-narrower hidden spec (h2) must resolve to a non-max candidate. adversarial_inputs=2: hidden h3 (conflict -> exit 2) and h4 (malformed range token -> exit 1) probe error paths; the fresh install re-runs pip on the manifest. unsafe_action_penalty=1: globaying pip install into the system python (PEP 668 nudge) is both tempting and a literal failure. quantitative_correctness=2: exact pins, exact lock, byte-equality of the logged example run against a live re-run seeded by the session env.

quartz-haven.notes: Medium: build a stateful WSGI bulk-ingestion service whose correctness must hold at thousands-of-assets scale (10k single bulk, 80x120 batches, ~2k lookups) under enforced wall-clock limits. resource_pressure=2 (scale/time probes), interaction_statefulness=1 (cumulative totals across batches, atomic 400s), adversarial_inputs=1 (invalid/duplicate/empty batches, 404s), quantitative_correctness=1 (float tolerance on aggregated value), hidden_case_generalization=1 (fresh hidden payloads), reasoning_depth=1 (all-or-nothing validation + cumulative totals), dependent_stages=1 (summary.json is derived from running the service on the fixture).

quartz-helix.notes: Hard. The agent must author a single deterministic multi-command tool /app/clean.py and run it against shipped /app/data to emit /app/result.json and /app/top.tsv (dependent_stages=3: write tool -> run org transform -> run top-k transform). tool_breadth=3 because seven distinct transform contracts must each be implemented and honored (nested JSON graph with strict nesting/sorted-key/no-duplicate cardinality, entity-name-or-account filter, top-k frequency ranking, boolean-column-detected grouped aggregations, per-invoice total-with-fallback plus conflict reconciliation, hourly linear-interpolation with boundary fallback, exactly-2-field JSON Lines). quantitative_correctness=3: every aggregate, count, interpolated value, and top-k count is compared exactly with tolerance; ordering (sorted dept keys, asc-url tie-break, preserved record order, every hourly step) is strict. hidden_case_generalization=3: the verifier re-invokes /app/clean.py on four fresh scenarios with edge inputs (dedup of duplicate names, dept with zero staff, orphan project rows, case-insensitive entity match plus account-only match, non-matching companies, missing tax -> null, missing due -> paid fallback, total-vs-due conflict, leading/trailing hourly gaps with boundary fallback and interior interpolation, empty cells, exactly-two-field JSONL). adversarial_inputs=2 (ties, dupes, gaps, mixed boolean tokens 0/1/yes/no). The hard floor comes from the nested multi-CSV org-graph competency (unique dept ids, min cardinality, sorted-by-key) which is the max competency floor.

quartz-hollow.documented_probe: C-1f4f846b (run the target application with the derived secret): exercised at the reference floor (hard). The verifier refuses the reward unless the side-effect file /app/releases/commit.token exists and byte-matches a fresh run of the shipped signer with the derived credential, so abstaining from running the app (no output file) fails.
quartz-hollow.notes: Two dependent stages: (1) reverse-engineer the v2 key-tape container (big-endian record framing, three pad encodings: raw / bit-complement / ascii-hex, per-shard pad selectors, and a reassembly manifest that differs from file order; the shipped v1 reader and spec are deliberately stale references), then (2) actually run /app/signer.py with the recovered credential so it emits the side-effect file. Hidden cases replay the generic decoder against fresh tapes (different pads, encodings, shard orders, credentials) and re-run the app with the derived secret. Nonzero rubric for dependent_stages, reasoning_depth (multi-record binary parsing + stale-doc reconciliation), hidden_case_generalization, quantitative_correctness (byte-exact token), and interaction_statefulness (side-effect must come from a real app run).

quartz-marsh.notes: Single program plus two artifacts: derive a hidden width H from a min/max combined-parameter budget (P = F*H + H + C*H + C), build torch nn.Linear instance_encoder and bag_classifier with consistent shapes, save the state dict, and emit a truthful report the verifier recomputes. One hidden config admits exactly one feasible H, so hard-coded or arbitrary widths fail the initialization adequacy checks (presence, non-None, shape consistency, finite values, budget). Rubric: tool_breadth (torch), reasoning_depth (closed-form budget solve), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (3 hidden configs incl. single-solution), quantitative_correctness (exact parameter counts).

quartz-orchid.notes: Medium (total 13). Four independent data-integrity pipelines, each requiring exact, byte/numeric-correct output that the verifier independently recomputes (quantitative_correctness=3): (1) reproducible GNU tar that must not dereference symlinks, must carry >100-char and deeply nested member names verbatim, and must stamp EVERY member mtime with the env-provided BUILD_EPOCH (or the fallback 1630454400), verified by re-running the archive builder against a hidden source tree with a fresh epoch (hidden_case_generalization=3); (2) a splitter that must fragment an oversized stream into chunks each ≤ a byte cap and keep them reassembleable via a recorded inverse, so the round trip is byte-exact for hidden non-multiple, exact-multiple and tiny-cap inputs (dependent_stages=2: split then join); (3) extracting a target member from a password-encrypted 7z archive using the on-disk credential by actually running the extraction; (4) a digested-tree walker that applies PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (fixed hex salt, 100000 iterations, 32-byte key) to every regular file and emits sorted relpath/tab/digest lines, checked by recomputation on both the visible tree and a hidden nested tree with binary and empty files. tool_breadth=2 (tar, p7zip/7z, python/hashlib). Reasoning is shallow per stage (reasoning_depth=1) but exactly-correct bytes/mtimes/digests are required; an imprecise epoch, a dereferenced symlink, a malformed chunk, or a wrong salt fails the corresponding gate. An agent missing any single competency fails at least one independent check; no deliverable is derivable from the pristine image.

quartz-relay.notes: Single competency C-3c94d62d (transform plain-text files via scripted editor vim macros): compose one headless vim script whose substitution pattern rewrites every shapeable telemetry row (<date>;<CODE>;<LABEL> -> <LABEL> [<CODE>] <DD>.<MM>.<YYYY>) and leaves every other row byte-for-byte unchanged; the script must also accept explicit file arguments for hidden replay. Small rubric nonzero for tool_breadth (headless vim invocation mode), reasoning_depth (whole-line anchored shape with three constrained groups), debugging_ambiguity (edge rows: malformed dates, empty labels, extra separators, indentation), adversarial_inputs (malformed rows must be untouched), hidden_case_generalization (script re-run on fresh hidden feeds), and quantitative_correctness (byte-for-byte equality).

quartz-relic.notes: Single-stage: author a self-contained importable package /app/dotkit whose root module exposes dot() (scalar product of two numeric sequences) with a documented contract (empty sequences, length mismatch ValueError, no input mutation). The isolation-copy import check rules out depending on the frozen loose module /app/dotlib.py. Nonzero rubric for reasoning_depth (package structure + self-containment), adversarial_inputs and hidden_case_generalization (12 hidden numeric/edge/error cases run in fresh interpreters), and quantitative_correctness (exact numeric results). No tool breadth, dependency chain, environment pressure, or statefulness; totals bucket to medium.

quartz-rune.notes: Hard: the agent must compile isqrt-then-Fibonacci-mod-2^32 into a strictly topological, size-capped (520 nodes) combinational operator network. Reasoning depth comes from the wraparound-safe restoring isqrt (guard the DIF with LESS/PICK) and the fast-doubling Fibonacci selected per input-dependent bit; quantitative_correctness is exact on every probed input including boundaries and near-squares. The grader re-evaluates the network with an independent interpreter on hidden inputs and separately executes the agent validator, so a papered-over circuit cannot pass.

quartz-summit.notes: Hard small-scale ML harness bundling four strands that must all hold: (1) train 300-dim word2vec-style embeddings on a token corpus via a reusable script interface the harness re-runs on a fresh corpus, and reach a cosine-Spearman STS cut-off > 0.70 plus topic-aware nearest neighbours; (2) train a value-iteration RL policy on a discrete grid environment with boundary clipping and an inclusive-euclidean-radius goal reward, clearing a mean-return threshold across trials and satisfying step edge cases; (3) run subsampling-stability (prediction-strength) clustering that returns the correct optimal k on fresh point sets; (4) keep a deterministic, tokenizable corpus/STS contract. Difficulty is hard because most claimed competencies carry hard floors; it comes from dependent multi-stage reasoning (the embedding artifact feeds both neighbour and STS checks; the script must generalise when re-run on hidden inputs), strict quantitative tolerances (exact 300-dim, spearman threshold, optimal-k and reward thresholds), and hidden-case generalisation across a new corpus, a new environment config, and new cluster datasets.

quartz-upland.notes: Hard (total 19). dependent_stages=3: the pipeline has four independent numeric components (dtype-aware softmax, covariance-weighted risk, 1-D transport, log-concave rejection sampler) plus a Python2->Python3 reporting port; every one must land or the verifier rejects. tool_breadth=3: the agent must write numpy numerics with per-dtype stability, handle degenerate transport inputs, run a Monte-Carlo log-concavity check, and do a pathlib/configparser/pandas utf-8 port. reasoning_depth=2: stable softmax (max-shift) and a correct finite-grid log-concavity test must be derived, not copied. adversarial_inputs=3: hidden cases include extreme softmax scores (overflow-prone), empty/single/identical/mismatched distributions, a bimodal target that must be rejected, and n<=0 / non-callable sampler arguments. hidden_case_generalization=3: the verifier imports the solver module and runs every function family on fresh hidden inputs, plus reruns the CLI to regenerate answer.json and the converted reporting script. quantitative_correctness=3: risk must match a float64 reference within rtol=1e-9, attention-sum within per-dtype tolerances (fp64 1e-12, fp32/mixed 1e-5, fp16 2e-3), and the reporting port must match pandas-averaged expectations. Hard bucket requires >=2 in a dimension; reasoning_depth, adversarial_inputs, dependent_stages all >=2.

quartz-wharf.notes: A self-written adaptive ODE/IVP integrator must hit a fine-grained DOP853 reference inside an absolute tolerance while never exceeding a hard ceiling on RHS-evaluation count and never emitting NaN/Inf, across four genuinely different hidden systems (damped pendulum with randomized initial states, van der Pol on a logarithmic grid, a high-frequency rotation on a coarse non-uniform grid, and a stiff scalar on a two-point minimal span). An eigen module must return the true largest-magnitude eigenvalue for non-symmetric matrices with complex eigenpairs and reconstruct the leading-principal-minor spectra row, all bounded in runtime against a numpy reference. A third deliverable must generate synthetic random portfolios and compare the serial path against the vectorized/parallel batched path (correctness and a reproducible speed-up), and the batched path must independently beat a serial loop by a required factor. Difficulty is hard: reasoning_depth and debugging_ambiguity are 3 (numeric stability vs an eval budget is genuinely iterative), hidden_case_generalization 3 and quantitative_correctness 3 (outputs compared against independently computed DOP853/np.eigvals references drift small), adversarial_inputs 2 (coarse grids, two-point spans, high-frequency and stiff dynamics that foil naive fixed-step integrators).

quay-ledger.documented_probe: C-349c1e3e (bulk-load a csv file into the database through the client copy command): this task directly covers the competency on the required second independent scenario; the verifier fully checks the capability (client-copy statement evidence plus loaded rows) on hidden cases.
quay-ledger.notes: Single-stage: drive the sqlite3 CLI client-side copy (.import) to bulk-load a header-bearing CSV into a prescribed table, handling quoted commas, escaped quotes, embedded newlines, CRLF, negative values, header-only and single-row CSVs, and separate read-only input / writable output directories. The verifier enforces both the resulting database contents and the .import statement evidence, so loads by any other method fail. Rubric is nonzero for tool_breadth (subprocess + sqlite3 CLI), reasoning_depth (header handling and CLI fallback), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (four hidden scenarios), and quantitative_correctness (exact rows/counts). Totals bucket to medium.

quiet-bridge.notes: Write a general binary framed-stream decoder (magic marker, little-endian uint16 length, sequence byte, payload, modulo-256 checksum) that must work on any conforming input. Solid at medium: byte-level parsing and endianness demand exact quantitative correctness; the checksum-validated error-recovery (corrupt/truncated/declared-length-mismatched frames must be discarded while garbage is ignored) adds debugging ambiguity about what counts as discarded; the verifier exercises 4 fresh hidden inputs (reordering, corruption, truncation, zero-length payloads, whitespace/dup seq) forcing generalization beyond the sample. No multi-stage pipeline, breadth, resource, statefulness, or unsafe-action pressure.

quiet-keel.documented_probe: C-06ebb4a9 (change the default login shell of a user and persist it): second independent covering task. The verifier executes the reusable deliverable script on hidden (user, shell) cases and checks the getent passwd lookup reports the new shell with all other account fields untouched, plus clean-failure cases.
quiet-keel.notes: Small chain: write a validating, idempotent set-shell script, apply the runbook entry persistently, record the outcome. Rubric nonzero for dependent_stages (apply then record), tool_breadth (usermod/getent), adversarial_inputs (nonexistent user, non-executable shell must fail cleanly), hidden_case_generalization (hidden user/shell pairs). Buckets to easy.

quiet-loom.documented_probe: C-9feab250 (configure a jupyter server via its config file to override port, listen address, and auth settings): covered at easy by a profile-file-driven port (instead of an environment variable), a wildcard listen address, and profile fallback semantics; the verifier fully checks the capability on hidden cases. Documented probe waiver.
quiet-loom.notes: Single deliverable: a Jupyter Server config module whose listen port is derived at load time from a JSON deployment profile with strict validation and a default fallback, wildcard ip, and token/password disabled. Hidden cases rotate the profile (alternate ports, missing key, out-of-range, malformed) and are checked both statically (config-loader content check) and live (server binds the right port on a non-loopback interface and answers a tokenless 200). Small rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (profile validation + fallback) and adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (multiple rotated profiles).

quiet-vellum.notes: Single-stage sysadmin change: flip an account's default login shell and make sure it lands in the persistent account database (failure mode: shell installed but never recorded as default). Generalization probe: the provisioner is re-executed on hidden user/shell pairs, and idempotency is exercised by running it twice. Small nonzero for dependent_stages (provision then consistent report), hidden_case_generalization, and interaction_statefulness (persistent /etc/passwd state). No tool breadth, pressure, or unsafe actions; buckets to easy.

quill-anchor.notes: Single-stage module+CLI deliverable: parse two CSV transport ledgers (comma- or whitespace-separated, blank lines ignored), validate shapes, take the dot product, root-clamp to non-negative, and return the square root as the metric distance. Nonzero rubric for reasoning_depth (two interfaces + CSV parsing), debugging_ambiguity (unrooted-squared-cost is the classic trap; must root and clamp, and surface errors as ValueError/exit 1 without tracebacks), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (negative clamp, zero plan, transposed mismatch, ragged, tiny magnitudes, rectangular, int/float mix), and quantitative_correctness (float distance compared to independently recomputed values). No dependency chain, no environment pressure; totals bucket to medium.

quill-fathom.documented_probe: C-d1d1b8cb (write and save a reusable fine-tuning script): covered directly and exercised at hard difficulty; the verifier re-executes the delivered script on hidden folds with unseen sizes, class balances and rule perturbations, enforces the fixed base-checkpoint path, snapshot divergence from base, accuracy >= 0.90 per fold, and the documented error contract (missing label column / zero-row fold must exit non-zero).
quill-fathom.notes: Single focused deliverable pair: a reusable fine-tuning script plus the artifact it produces on the visible fold. Scenario (print-shop press-fold threshold drift over a frozen 3-class 16->24->3 checkpoint) is independent of umber-vault's full split/train/predict/bag pipeline. Base checkpoint is calibrated below 0.90 on every fold (0.82-0.91), so copying base fails; a correct capped-epoch fine-tune reaches ~1.0 (oracle-verified on all folds). Rubric: reasoning_depth (training-loop design, error contract), hidden_case_generalization (3 hidden folds with distinct drifts/sizes), adversarial_inputs (malformed folds), quantitative_correctness (accuracy threshold), dependent_stages (artifact must be produced by running the script).

quill-vane.notes: Core difficulty is reading three photographed snippets with exact fidelity (small, low-contrast, speckled images where OCR mangles operators/underscores/digits) and re-implementing them; a single misread character changes the computed value. Three different function shapes (loop+arithmetic, string scanning with modular char arithmetic, weighted list fold with normalization) exercise reasoning_depth; hidden probes re-run the same program with fresh arguments so hard-coded answers fail. Deterministic, no tool breadth, no resource pressure.

raven-anchor.notes: One /app/clean.py pipeline must satisfy eight coordinated sub-tasks (boolean-column-detected grouped aggregation, a fixed-shape period/severity/count table, a nested dept->emp->project graph ordered by key with de-duplication, a category/product-id groupable table, entity filtering resolved across a closed alias/canonical lookup set including direct-owner and owner-name variants, top-5 URL frequency ranking with count ties, an hourly series filled by linear interpolation with leading/trailing boundary fallback, and per-paper two-field JSON Lines records). Hidden cases (a/b/c) exercise genuinely different data: a boolean column whose vocabulary is broken so boolean-column detection must drop it, duplicate/empty/malformed values, a target entity resolved only through an alias variant, single-point and fully-empty series giving boundary fallback and empty-span handling, empty filtered/paper sets, and whitespace/case noise. The verifier recomputes every artifact from scratch with its own reference and requires a full match, so an agent that memorizes the visible outputs fails all hidden runs. Difficulty is hard because the max competency floor across the spec's three competencies is hard (claimed C-f4c1e942 closed-set entity filter carries a hard floor; dropped C-d3c284ae was also hard), forcing the task above the nominal medium target; total rubric 18 (hard bucket 18-30) with reasoning_depth=3, dependent_stages=3, hidden_case_generalization=3, quantitative_correctness=3.

raven-jetty.notes: Total 19 => hard bucket (>=18), satisfying the hard floor of competency C-b45b6939 (author a compact independent C implementation). The task chains four build stages that must all be produced and all re-verified fresh: (1) a static C clone of the recovered 'shoal' byte transform that is rebuilt by test.sh from source in a clean scratch dir (no /app includes, no reference binary) and must reproduce the documented byte-exact transform on hidden binary inputs, (2) wiring the engine's public header directory onto the preprocessor include path (CPATH) so clang resolves <hull/engine.h>, (3) compiling one source under distinct flag sets and instrumentation (fast -O2 -DNDEBUG vs debug -g -O0 --coverage) and reproducing the mode-specific behavior (different computed value, coverage .gcno/.gcda only where instrumentation is on), and (4) repairing the as-shipped toy compiler so it rejects variable-length arrays (a feature it genuinely lacks) with a non-zero error instead of silently compiling them. debugging_ambiguity=3: the toy compiler ships with its VLA-rejection guard disabled (the bug is easy to miss because the code path compiles and prints ok), and the build-mode stage requires understanding why only the instrumented binary emits coverage artifacts and what each flag set actually changes. dependent_stages=3: each competency gate is a separate deliverable produced by executing its own script, and the clone rebuild, include-path, build-modes, and toycc hidden checks all depend on the agent having produced working sources/scripts first. adversarial_inputs=2 (hidden inputs include empty and NUL-bearing binary fixtures, macro/non-literal VLA sizes, and fresh build-mode start/end ranges); hidden_case_generalization=2 (the clone is rebuilt and re-run on hidden inputs; build-modes runs with fresh arguments; toycc is recompiled and probed with hidden VLA and non-VLA sources).

raven-mantle.notes: Hard (bucket total = 20). One executable adapter (/app/infer.py) must carry the full self-play inference close-out end to end: (dependent_stages=3) load the offline causal LM+tokenizer with local_files_only, reconfigure a seq-classification head to a variable custom count and save it, run a causal-LM forward with a loss floor, apply the bag-MIL forward (encoder + attention gate + classifier returning logits + unit-sum attention which survives even a malformed empty bag), apply the policy/WDL head forward (legal-move logits + post-softmax outcome vector), and bundle a streaming request log into aligned micro-batches under four metric thresholds. Quantitative correctness=3: the loss-txt must equal the reference that 'averages over micro-batches' to within 1e-3 (the trailing short micro-batch makes naive full-set averaging wrong), the reconfigured head config must carry the exact count and give a (1,count) forward, and every /app/engine byte must stay byte-identical (hashed vs build-time manifest). reasoning_depth=3 : correct grad-accumulation rescale plus feasibility reasoning for all four batching thresholds at once. adversarial_inputs=2 and hidden_case_generalization=2: three hidden cases re-run every mode with different geometries (bag/state sizes, class counts, request streams), plus edge/malformed inputs (empty bag, zero legal-moves, single stripped request, head count 1) which must remain valid. Bucket total = 20 -> hard, meeting the hardest claimed floor (C-1ca974ef, hard).

raven-orchid.notes: Hard bucket (18/30). Four dependent stages with real tool breadth: ingest.py must run a local HTTP server, fetch+sha256(url)-name media, drive ffmpeg for audio extraction, cover with the bundled vosk ASR model, and normalize transcripts; stack/peaks/animation each implement a precise numeric/structural contract. reasoning_depth=3: exact deterministic hashing, ASR pipeline correctness, stable tie-breaking peak ranking, and declared-vs-actual keyframe consistency must all hold simultaneously. hidden_case_generalization=3: 4 hidden scenarios re-execute all four programs on fresh inputs. quantitative_correctness=3: exact sha256 filenames, exact descending-magnitude bin order, exact stacked arrays/shapes, exact shape strings. adversarial_inputs=2: hidden cases include blank URL lines, ?query strings, 404 URLs, audio-with-no-video, EMPTY/INCOMPATIBLE TIFF dirs, negative/overflow/zero k, zero/negative counts, and invalid-JSON animation specs. Max competency floor is hard (C-f39f2732, C-7c5452ae), so the derived bucket is hard.

reed-haven.documented_probe: C-ac4a9918 (declare the mailing-list configuration in the canonical file): covering task at the documented medium floor; the verifier fully exercises the capability (config must live at the fixed /etc/listd/config.toml path and actually drive the list manager on hidden command streams; a config anywhere else is refused).
reed-haven.notes: Two-stage: author an idempotent provisioning script that installs the canonical listd config (normalized roster from a messy sign-up sheet, closed/open flags, member caps) and replays the visible stream to produce the roster report. Hidden cases replay unseen administrative streams through the daemon with the agent's canonical config (closed-list refusal, cap enforcement, duplicates, moderator posting, case normalization, malformed commands) plus a wrong-path refusal proof. Small rubric nonzero for the provision->report dependency, reasoning depth (normalization + check-order rules), debugging ambiguity (idempotency + daemon exit codes), adversarial inputs (malformed stream lines), hidden generalization, and quantitative correctness. Totals bucket to medium.

river-ledger.notes: Medium. Sequential replay of a JSONL journal with duplicate suppression, correction-reset semantics, and a rich malformed-input set. Hidden cases force a general, runnable program (executes-deliverable). Debugging ambiguity and adversarial-input handling carry the difficulty; no heavy tools, I/O pressure, or safety constraints.

rose-frame.documented_probe: C-13d03a72 (produce byte-identical converter output across independent runs): reference floor is hard but the covering task exercises it at medium; the verifier fully checks the capability on hidden cases. Documented probe waiver.
rose-frame.notes: A compact procedural renderer task. Difficulty comes mostly from required generalization to arbitrary hidden scenes (the tool is re-run on multiple fresh inputs) plus byte-exact correctness: the deliverable must run, be a reusable program, handle clipped/off-canvas/zero-size/adverse geometry, respect painter order, and emit a deterministic P6 PPM matching the reference under binary byte comparison. Cannot be passed by copying a scene-specific answer, so fixed-output cheating is structurally impossible.

rust-bazaar.documented_probe: C-d1d1b8cb (write and save a reusable fine-tuning script): the competency's reference floor is hard and this task exercises it at hard — the verifier fully checks the capability (base-snapshot reuse by shape, capped CPU fine-tune, changed loadable snapshot, fold accuracy >= 0.90 on unseen hidden folds, graceful non-zero exits).
rust-bazaar.notes: Single deliverable pair: a reusable fine-tuning script plus the artifact from one visible run. The script must (1) load a pretrained Linear(24->48)/ReLU/Linear(48->3) state_dict identified by tensor shape regardless of parameter naming, (2) fine-tune on CPU within a capped schedule (<60 epochs), (3) emit a new loadable snapshot that differs from the base, (4) generalize to hidden folds whose labeling rules are independent of the base rule and of each other, each reaching accuracy >= 0.90, and (5) exit non-zero with a stderr diagnostic on missing columns, zero-row folds, or non-finite features. Rubric: hidden_case_generalization=3 (three hidden folds with independent rules), adversarial_inputs=2 (malformed/empty/unbalanced-schema folds), quantitative_correctness=2 (accuracy bar plus snapshot validity/differs checks), reasoning_depth=2 (shape-based loading + adaptation), dependent_stages=1 (script -> artifact chain), debugging_ambiguity=1. No resource pressure, interaction, or unsafe surface.

rust-quay.notes: Covering task for C-ce46ee62 (reverse a single-key byte transform to recover the valid WAL). Medium: agent must recover the XOR key from the WAL magic (both checksum-endian variants allowed), invert the transform over the whole file, and replay never-checkpointed rows from the restored WAL via SQLite. Dependent stages (decode then extract), mild reasoning (unique-key argument over 256 candidates), adversarial awareness (SQLite may checkpoint/delete the -wal if opened in place; the tool must operate on copies), quantitative correctness (byte-exact WAL, exact JSON rows). Hidden cases use different keys, lengths and row sets; a hard-coded tool fails. No resource pressure or statefulness.

rust-quill.documented_probe: Covering task for C-446b41c3 (compute the sqrt wasserstein distance from the transport cost). Distinct from iris-terrace: standalone freight-desk module+CLI with a single rooted-distance deliverable and root-clamp/negative-dot probes, instead of one section of a multi-part numerics fitting task.
rust-quill.notes: Single module + CLI: dot product of plan and cost, clamp to non-negative, square root, JSON out. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (metric vs squared-cost distinction), debugging_ambiguity (the classic unrooted bug is the trap), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (zero plan, negative dot, rectangular, larger matrices), quantitative_correctness (exact float distances recomputed independently).

rustic-ledger.notes: Medium. Core is a git-like reachability walk over a content-addressed store combined with a self-hash verification (filename must equal sha256 of canonical payload) and regex credential scanning confined to reachable blobs. Difficulty lives in hidden-case generalization (must handle arbitrary stores) plus adversarial fixtures: corrupt objects, objects stored under mismatched filenames, a dangling or missing refs/HEAD, an AKIA/PRIVATE-KEY-style credential intentionally placed in an unreachable blob that must not be reported. Quantitative correctness is required to recompute digests from decoded bytes and report sorted unique IDs.

sable-codon.documented_probe: C-3f9a7c11 (reverse-complement / strand-orientation reasoning on nucleotide sequences): the covering task exercises it at hard — a misoriented or misordered reverse primer fails every hidden case. Documented probe waiver.
sable-codon.notes: Single-stage hard task: QuikChange-style centered mutagenic primer design over a possibly multi-record FASTA template with variable-length inserts (substitution/insertion/deletion), whole-primer Wallace Tm and GC windows, a three-level tie-break, and a strict ordered error taxonomy. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (strand orientation, 2-D flank search), debugging_ambiguity (tie-break precision), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (six hidden scenes incl. error tokens), and quantitative_correctness (exact sequences, integral Tm, rounded GC). No tool breadth, no dependency chain, no environment pressure.

sable-gauge.notes: Author a reproducible-archive packer: sort members by raw UTF-8 bytes (never locale collation) and normalize all owner/group identity out of the archive (uid/gid 0, uname/gname empty, mtime 0, fixed modes, ustar format) so identical input trees yield byte-identical tar output and a stable sha256 identity digest. Medium floor: deliverable is a runnable packer (/app/pack.py) plus the two artifacts from the shipped tree (/app/bundle.tar, /app/bundle.sha256); the verifier executes the packer on hidden trees whose names break locale collation (uppercase-before-lowercase, non-ASCII UTF-8), with empty files/dirs and deep nesting, and byte-compares archives and digests. Nonzero rubric for adversarial_inputs (collation traps), hidden_case_generalization (two distinct hidden trees), and quantitative_correctness (exact byte equality).

sable-heron.notes: Single-stage with a dependent artifact: write a reusable merge tool, then run it on the visible fixtures to emit the conflict report. Medium reasoning: two-sided normalization (greatest synced_at wins, last-occurrence tie-break within an export), cross-export conflict detection (values differ AND both sources present), and a dated-precedence winner rule with payroll winning ties. Adversarial: malformed array elements, missing/non-string fields, unparseable exports, duplicate rows, solo/agreeing pairs, empty results. Verifier reruns the program on hidden export pairs and checks pairs_considered, total_conflicts == len(conflicts), ordering, entries layout, and winner/winner_export.

sable-hook.notes: Multi-stage binary-re: locate and decode two XOR-obfuscated byte tables in a stripped ELF (objdump/hexdump work), validate the recovered passphrase against the real binary, then RUN the target application with the derived deploy secret so the vault body executes and emits its side-effect file. The verifier deletes the side-effect file and re-executes the runner, cross-checks the app's genuine output, verifies the binary and application are pristine and still reject wrong inputs, and replays hidden probes (self-sufficient runner without the passphrase file, fresh output dir, wrong-secret rejection). Nonzero rubric for dependency chain, RE tooling, disassembly reasoning, statefulness (must really run the app) and correctness; totals bucket to hard.

sable-marsh.documented_probe:
C-2dc20425 (verify registered model serialization and parameter shape): reference floor is easy; the covering task exercises it at easy. The verifier loads the persisted model with joblib, checks it is a genuine sklearn linear model, and checks the coefficient vector length equals the input feature count on visible and hidden cases, including a malformed input that must fail cleanly. Documented probe waiver.
C-4d2f3c04 (hit a documented held-out accuracy floor): exercised at easy with a recomputed independent accuracy check at 0.80. Documented probe waiver.
sable-marsh.notes: Single-stage: schema-driven LogisticRegression fit, serialize with joblib, register a JSON manifest. The agent must generalize to hidden datasets with different feature counts (3/4/6) and column names, keep the persisted object a genuine sklearn linear model with coefficient length equal to the feature count, match the manifest, clear a 0.80 holdout floor recomputed by the verifier, and fail cleanly on a missing-target column. Small rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (header-driven feature discovery), adversarial_inputs (malformed case), hidden_case_generalization (4 hidden cases), quantitative_correctness (exact shape/accuracy checks). No tool breadth, no dependency chain, no environment pressure; totals bucket to easy.

sable-mesa.notes: Single-stage: author a flat-layout setuptools package (pyproject.toml with dotkit package discovery), a dotkit/core.py scalar-product kernel, and a root-module re-export. Medium floor from packaging structure + import-path requirements; hidden cases cover ints/floats/negatives/tuples/empty and a ValueError length-mismatch, so hidden_case_generalization and quantitative_correctness are nonzero. No environment pressure, no statefulness; totals bucket to medium.

sable-orbit.notes: Single-stage: isolate objective.reported among decoy fields and persist its integer part (floor) as exactly the digits plus one newline; byte-exact match punishes float formatting or stray whitespace. Hidden cases probe fractional floor-down, exponent notation, already-integral values, and sub-unit values. Small rubric nonzero for adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (four hidden reports) and quantitative_correctness (exact byte match). No tool breadth, dependency chain, or environment pressure; totals bucket to easy.

sable-prism.notes: Medium: the agent must pip-install the vendored (not pre-installed) prismval harness offline, author the JSON task wiring (ordered choices list plus a gold_map that translates the deliberately scrambled label-codebook into choice indices), write an argument-driven eval driver, and run it so the visible baseline lands exactly on the independently recomputed accuracy window. The failure mode is mis-wired choice order / gold mapping, which collapses accuracy to near chance (0.03 vs 0.94 on the visible set), far outside the window. Hidden cases generalize the driver to fresh datasets with skipped rows (missing ids, out-of-range codes), empty and unknown-token texts that fall back to the class bias, and tie-breaking by model class order.

sable-quill.documented_probe: C-f01d36d3 (expose required entry-point functions under required names): the verifier regex-checks the obliged definitions at line start in the R source and re-runs both entry points (numeric hidden cases, error edge, reproducibility, self-test exit/PASS) in fresh R processes. Verifier fully checks the capability.
sable-quill.notes: Single-stage data_science task: author an R module exposing tide_estimate/tide_selftest under exact names (line-start regex), a seeded exponential Monte-Carlo estimator with argument validation, and a recorded PASS/FAIL self-test log. Nonzero rubric for reasoning_depth (seeding/validation contract), adversarial_inputs (error edge cases), hidden_case_generalization (fresh n/rate combos in fresh R processes), quantitative_correctness (estimate vs 1/rate); buckets to medium.

sable-ray.notes: Hard single-focus reverse-engineering task: a compiled, source-free C target (/app/target/raycaster, built at image build time from an aux source removed from the image) renders a two-stage scene operation on a heightmap - a horizontal median-of-3 despike with clamped windows, then a west->east raycast shadow pass with slope-1 clearance falloff and STRICT comparison, emitting 'LIT <count>' plus a #/. mask. The agent must recover every semantic detail purely by probe grids and/or objdump/gdb (median window+clamping, ray direction, exact falloff, strict-vs-tie behavior, exact output bytes) and reimplement it in pure Python that matches byte-for-byte on hidden grids probing ties, descending-by-1 ramps, edge spikes, W=1/W=2 rows, 0/255 extremes, and 512-wide grids. Differs from calm-hearth's RE subtask (3x3 blur convolution, space-separated integer output): different operation class (morphological filter + ray march vs linear convolution), different output contract (mask art + summary line vs integer grid), and the reimplementation is pure-Python-only (no native invocation). Rubric total 15 -> hard; reasoning_depth 3 (two interacting passes + strictness corner), debugging_ambiguity 2 (multiple plausible models fit partial probes), quantitative_correctness 2 (byte-identical output).

sable-vellum.notes: Wire a 3-way multiple-choice classification task into an installed micro lm-eval harness: author the YAML config (choice order defines gold indices, so a wrong order or gold mapping collapses accuracy far below the graded 0.60-0.95 window), write a generic HTTP dataset driver, and produce the visible result over loopback HTTP. The verifier re-runs the driver on hidden corpora served over HTTP and recomputes every metric independently. Rubric marks: dependency chain (config -> driver -> served run), tool breadth (YAML + HTTP + harness import), reasoning depth (argmax/tie/skip semantics), adversarial inputs (skipped labels, empty text, decoy columns, case folding), hidden generalization and quantitative correctness (exact recomputed metrics), statefulness (loopback server lifecycle).

sable-wicket.notes: Total 6 (easy bucket 0-6). Five audited single-line defects, each located by an exact line number and excerpt; the agent must transcribe one correct fix request per finding and apply them through the stateful patchdeck applier under a hard budget of one attempt per finding (any rejected or extra attempt fails the run). difficulty comes from the precise request protocol (statefulness) rather than from reasoning depth; the delivered library is re-tested on hidden vectors per the docstring contracts, and the log is cryptographically tied to the delivered file's lines.

saffron-chain.notes: Implement a real bounded random-walk Metropolis sampler for a truncated normal and generalize to fresh configs (different support/center/scale/n/seed). Difficulty comes from the statistical-correctness requirements: hidden cases probe support enforcement, heavy truncation (moments far off center/scale require truncated-normal math, not naive untruncated samples), exact retained count after burn-in, and fixed-seed reproducibility. A plausible-looking but wrong sampler (uniform draws, ignoring truncation, or leaking burn-in) fails the moment/count checks, so quantitative_correctness, hidden_case_generalization and adversarial_inputs carry the score. Single self-contained stdlib file; no external deps.

saffron-dial.documented_probe: C-f01d36d3 (expose required entry-point functions under required names): covered here at medium; the verifier discovers the two required R functions by line-anchored regex, then fresh-loads the file and exercises them on hidden survey vectors plus error and self-test cases.
saffron-dial.notes: Two required top-level R definitions discovered by regex, then genuinely executed on hidden inputs (varied log bases, zeros, empty/all-zero/single-species vectors, fractional abundances, invalid-input error cases, and a fresh self-test rerun). Rubric credits the R toolchain, edge-case numerics, hidden generalization, and exact quantitative agreement.

saffron-ember.documented_probe: C-d1d1b8cb (write and save a reusable fine-tuning script): reference floor is hard; this covering task requires a reusable CLI fine-tuner that reloads a shape-identified deployed snapshot, adapts it to previously-unseen drifted folds (accuracy >= 0.90 where the base scores near chance), writes new valid checkpoints, refuses over-cap epochs and malformed folds, and never mutates the base artifact.
saffron-ember.notes: Drift-adaptation fine-tuner: the base model (built into the image, trained on last season's water-mass layout) scores ~0.33 on the drifted folds, so a copy-the-base or dummy-snapshot solution fails the 0.90 threshold; genuine SGD adaptation within the 30-epoch cap is required. hidden_case_generalization=2 (two unseen drift regimes with different fold sizes), adversarial_inputs=2 (missing label column, zero-row fold, non-numeric feature, --epochs over cap must all exit non-zero), unsafe_action_penalty=1 (the base snapshot must remain byte-identical), quantitative_correctness=1 (accuracy threshold + printed metric), modest reasoning_depth/tool_breadth (torch stack, CSV handling), dependent_stages=1 (load base -> fine-tune -> save).

saffron-loom.notes: Two-stage: write a reusable CLI exporter, then run it on the visible fixtures to produce the delivered JSONL. The competency (filter one locale subset, export requested columns as JSONL with exact row count/column names) is checked at medium floor: two dataset shapes (bare array vs {'records': ...} wrapper), missing/non-string/wrong-case locale rows, missing columns emitted as '', empty dataset, zero-match locale, exact row count and column order on every hidden case. Rubric nonzero for dependent_stages (program + delivered artifact), reasoning_depth (two shapes + field-absence semantics), adversarial_inputs and hidden_case_generalization (4 hidden cases), quantitative_correctness (exact rows/columns). No tool breadth, resource pressure, or statefulness; totals bucket to medium.

saffron-mesa.notes: Fit a multinomial Naive Bayes model from a CSV corpus (exact tokenization, Laplace smoothing, priors) and persist it to a pickle file at a fixed path. The verifier reloads the pickle and checks the exact dict layout, sorted class/vocab lists, and smoothed log-probabilities against a reference, then re-runs the deliverable on hidden corpora (different class set, punctuation-only documents). Nonzero rubric for the fit-then-persist chain, adversarial empty-token documents, hidden generalization, and numeric correctness.

saffron-quay.notes: Single Flask service with an exactly-specified lexicon classifier: label tie-breaking (positive/negative/mixed/neutral) plus add-one-smoothed per-class confidence rounding, one batch-scoring CLI mode that must generalize to hidden inputs, and HTTP contract details (content-type gate, 400 error bodies, health endpoint). Nonzero rubric for tool_breadth (HTTP server + CLI), reasoning_depth (tie-break + smoothing arithmetic), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (empty text, ties, punctuation/case, malformed requests), quantitative_correctness (rounded float confidences), interaction_statefulness (live server polled by the verifier).
